findings.label: IgG4-positive plasma cell infiltration
findings.evidence: Caption: "abundant infiltration of IgG4-bearing plasma cells" in pancreatic tissue in AIP.

panels.rationale: Single-panel IgG4 immunohistochemical image of pancreatic tissue from autoimmune pancreatitis, showing abundant IgG4-bearing plasma cell infiltration, a characteristic manifestation of IgG4-related disease. [raw subtype: IgG4-related autoimmune pancreatitis]
panels.attribution_text: Kawa. Immunoglobulin G4-related Disease: An Overview.. JMA journal 2019. doi:10.31662/jmaj.2018-0017. CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Figure 4.
panels.figure_caption: IgG4 immunostaining of pancreatic tissue in AIP showing abundant infiltration of IgG4-bearing plasma cells (×400 magnification).
in_text_mentions: In 2002, we described the characteristic histological features of abundant IgG4-bearing plasma cell infiltration in affected pancreatic tissues, which constituted another pathological hallmark of AIP (Figure 4) (3).
